item.title: [9] 3D bulk-resolved g-wave altermagnetic order parameter in CrSb
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: F. Malte Grosche, Alexander G. Eaton

Authors: Mengmeng Long, Theodore I. Weinberger, Zheyu Wu, et al.

Score 9/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Crucial study of altermagnetism and spin splitting using bulk-sensitive quantum oscillations.

Tags: #CrSb #altermagnetism #quantumoscillations

Abstract: Quantum oscillation measurements map the g-wave altermagnetic order parameter in CrSb, establishing it as a prototypical unconventional magnet with momentum-dependent spin splitting.
